summary.text: Steven Schetrom is the Republican candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 86, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A financial advisor from Baker, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he has served as a Hardy County commissioner since January 2021.

paragraphs.text: Steven Schetrom was born in Petersburg, West Virginia, and earned a bachelor's degree from Shepherd University in 2003 and a graduate degree from Wake Forest University in 2008, according to Ballotpedia.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Hardy County, graduated from Moorefield High School in 1995, and has worked as a financial advisor since 2008.
He said he established his own Registered Investment Advisory firm, Legacy Financial, LLC, in 2010 and lives in Baker with his wife and two sons.
Schetrom said in that survey that he had declared his candidacy for West Virginia State Treasurer in 2024.
